title: Integrating machine learning and traditional statistics to evaluate the Uric acid-to-HDL cholesterol ratio for identification of prevalent COPD in older adults.
summary: Analysis of NHANES participants found an adjusted association between uric-acid/HDL ratio and prevalent COPD, with machine-learning analysis as a supplementary predictive check; the cross-sectional source explicitly does not support prospective-screening inference.
